_meta.description: Hard case: 160 patients, 47 numeric features (46 markers + age), only 4 informative and linear; 6 near-duplicate re-run assays (r > 0.95). Target ~41% positive (roughly balanced). The sound recommendation is a regularised linear model (L1/elastic-net logistic regression) with repeated stratified cross-validation; boosting or deep models overfit at n/p ≈ 3.4, and a single 20% holdout is only 32 patients.
known_characteristics: n=160, p=47 numeric features: high-dimensional for the sample size
4 informative markers with linear signal (|r| 0.2-0.45), the rest noise

data_readiness.note: Feature reduction / regularisation and duplicate handling are required first; 'ready' ignores the n/p problem.

decision_requirements.note: With 160 rows a single holdout is too noisy; use (repeated, stratified) k-fold CV.
The top model should be explicitly regularised for p close to n.
